checkpoints.description: Implement publish standards, AGL-1.1 license, and test suite (checklists: passed)

impact_assessment.why: Afterimage was not aligned with AIKit publish standards
impact_assessment.benefits: Full publish readiness, 100% test pass gate, automated verification
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: All tests self-contained in memory, zero external dependencies

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Prove the daily streak counts a lost run; extract pure streak advancement; wire and verify

impact_assessment.why: A failed daily run currently increments the streak (3-day becomes 4-day) and marks the day complete, contradicting the README promise that the streak grows each day you finish one
impact_assessment.benefits: Daily streak becomes truthful and testable; loss no longer mints streak progress or consumes the day; replay win still advances exactly one day
impact_assessment.risks: contract: daily save shape and menu copy unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: afterimage.daily last/streak on loss no longer written
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure helper with unit tests for loss, win, replay, gap, freeze and malformed input; scripted before/after daily-loss playthrough; full node and aikit gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Daily streak integrity verified with failing-first test, scripted daily loss/replay run, before/after screenshots and full gates (checklists: passed)
[1/3] Fix menu meta-row wrapping and pluralization; prove with same-state screenshot pair

impact_assessment.why: The menu status row packs three items into one flex line at 1440x900, each wrapping into two lines, and renders '1 runs'; the first impression is cramped and ungrammatical
impact_assessment.benefits: Status row reads as two clear bands (privacy note over eye level/streak), singular/plural labels are correct, and the menu height is stable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: menu copy only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none (profileLine is pure, storage untouched)
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure profileLine test first; CSS grid with baseline alignment; same seeded save state, viewport and screenshots before/after; full node and aikit gates

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Two-band menu grid, pluralization and 390px stack verified with failing-first test, same-state screenshots and a full Zen run (checklists: passed)
